from pocket_coffea.lib.objects import lepton_selection
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import cuts_object
from pocket_coffea.processor import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal PocketCoffea workflow for dimuon analysis."""
    
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        super().__init__(cfg)
        
    def object_preselection(self, variation):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        self.events["MuonGood"] = self.events.Muon[
            (self.events.Muon.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(self.events.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        
    def object_counting(self, variation):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        self.events["n_muons"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood)
